description: This is a Lua source file containing tests and demonstrations for various table library functions such as unpack, pack, move, and sort. It includes assertions, error checks, and performance tests to ensure correctness and efficiency of the Lua table operations.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Function to run a test expecting an error message when executing a given function with parameters.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Function to verify that a table is sorted according to a comparison function.

methods.name: timesort
methods.description: Function to measure and print the time taken to sort an array with a given comparison function.

methods.name: perm
methods.description: Recursive function to generate permutations of a list for testing sort orders.
